title: Verify safety and performance impact of energy source change
acceptance_criteria: Provide electrical safety/EMC testing per applicable standards (IEC 60601).|Demonstrate equivalent thermal/energy output under worst-case conditions.|Map all energy-related hazards to controls and verification evidence.
recommended_artifacts: Bench Test Report|Electrical Safety / EMC Report|FMEA / Hazard Analysis

title: Assess biocompatibility impact of material change
acceptance_criteria: Provide ISO 10993-1 biological evaluation rationale and endpoint coverage.|If testing required, attach final test reports and acceptance criteria.|Provide chemical characterization data for new materials.
recommended_artifacts: Chemical Characterization Report|Cytotoxicity/Sensitization/Irritation Summary|ISO 10993-1 Biological Evaluation Plan

title: Evaluate impact of tissue contact type change
acceptance_criteria: Update ISO 10993-1 biological evaluation for new contact type.|Identify additional biocompatibility endpoints required by new contact type.|Provide residual risk / benefit-risk justification for contact change.
recommended_artifacts: ISO 10993-1 Biological Evaluation Plan|Residual Risk / Benefit-Risk Justification

title: Provide clinical evidence to address identified gaps
acceptance_criteria: Conduct systematic literature review for applicable clinical evidence.|If literature insufficient, develop clinical study protocol.|Provide clinical rationale memo justifying evidence sufficiency.
recommended_artifacts: Clinical Protocol / Study Plan|Clinical Rationale Memo|Literature Review

title: Align intended use and indications with predicate
acceptance_criteria: Provide side-by-side intended use comparison with predicate.|Justify any differences with clinical evidence or bench bridging.|Confirm labeling/IFU reflects aligned indications.
recommended_artifacts: Clinical Rationale Memo|IFU Draft|Warnings / Precautions Update

title: Justify expanded indications for use
acceptance_criteria: Provide clinical evidence (literature or study) supporting expanded population.|Document risk/benefit analysis for new indications.|Attach clinical protocol / study plan if prospective data needed.
recommended_artifacts: Clinical Bridging Analysis|Clinical Protocol / Study Plan|Clinical Rationale Memo|Literature Review

title: Provide cybersecurity evidence for increased attack surface
acceptance_criteria: Provide SBOM with all software components and versions.|Attach threat model and security risk assessment.|Document vulnerability management and patch/update process.|Provide penetration testing summary if applicable.
recommended_artifacts: Patch / Update Process|SBOM|Vulnerability Assessment Summary

title: Justify continued use of predicate with elevated safety signals
acceptance_criteria: Document known safety signals for chosen predicate (recalls, MDRs).|Provide risk/benefit justification for continuing with this predicate.|Consider identifying alternate predicate without safety concerns.|Attach recall/safety signal summary with disposition.
recommended_artifacts: CAPA Summary|Recall / Safety Signal Summary

title: Address compromised predicate family safety lineage
acceptance_criteria: Document predicate lineage and associated safety events.|Provide risk management file addressing lineage concerns.|If lineage toxicity is significant, provide alternate predicate analysis.|Attach CAPA summary for any open corrective actions in lineage.
recommended_artifacts: CAPA Summary|ISO 14971 Risk Management Plan|Recall / Safety Signal Summary

title: Provide software lifecycle evidence for new/updated software
acceptance_criteria: Classify software level of concern (Class A/B/C per IEC 62304).|Provide software development lifecycle plan and artifacts.|Attach V&V summary, traceability matrix, and SOUP/OTS list.|Provide SBOM and threat model for cybersecurity review.
recommended_artifacts: IEC 62304 Software Development Plan|SBOM|SOUP List|Threat Model

title: Provide ML/AI controls and predetermined change control plan
acceptance_criteria: Provide Predetermined Change Control Plan (PCCP) for adaptive algorithms.|Document training/validation dataset characteristics and bias analysis.|Attach performance monitoring plan with drift detection methodology.|Provide algorithm verification evidence under expected operating conditions.
recommended_artifacts: IEC 62304 Software Development Plan|ISO 14971 Risk Management Plan|Verification & Validation Evidence

title: Provide interoperability testing and data integrity evidence
acceptance_criteria: Provide interface specification and interoperability test protocol.|Attach test results demonstrating accurate data exchange under fault conditions.|If applicable, provide vulnerability assessment for connected interfaces.
recommended_artifacts: Bench Test Report|Performance Verification Summary|Vulnerability Assessment Summary

title: Verify performance claims with bench/clinical evidence
acceptance_criteria: Provide bench test protocol with acceptance criteria for each performance claim.|Attach bench test report demonstrating claim verification.|If claims cannot be verified by bench alone, provide clinical bridging analysis.
recommended_artifacts: Bench Test Protocol|Bench Test Report|Clinical Bridging Analysis|Performance Verification Summary

title: Verify design architecture equivalence with predicate
acceptance_criteria: Provide design comparison document (subject vs. predicate architecture).|Attach bench test results demonstrating equivalent performance.|Document risk analysis addressing new design-related hazards.
recommended_artifacts: Bench Test Protocol|Bench Test Report|FMEA / Hazard Analysis

title: Demonstrate substantial equivalence despite technology differences
acceptance_criteria: Provide bench test protocol and results comparing subject vs. predicate performance.|Map technology differences to risk analysis and hazard controls.|Demonstrate equivalent performance under worst-case conditions.
recommended_artifacts: Bench Test Protocol|Bench Test Report|ISO 14971 Risk Management Plan

title: Evaluate impact of contact duration category change
acceptance_criteria: Update ISO 10993-1 evaluation to address new duration category.|If moving to longer duration, provide additional endpoint testing evidence.|Document rationale for any endpoint exemptions.
recommended_artifacts: Cytotoxicity/Sensitization/Irritation Summary|ISO 10993-1 Biological Evaluation Plan

title: Validate human factors for changed user interface
acceptance_criteria: Conduct formative and/or summative human factors studies.|Document use-related risk analysis and mitigations.|Update IFU to reflect any workflow or interface changes.
recommended_artifacts: Human Factors Validation Summary|IFU Draft|Warnings / Precautions Update

title: Document post-market surveillance signals and mitigations
acceptance_criteria: Provide complaint trending analysis for predicate and subject (if on market).|Attach CAPA summary for any open corrective actions.|If applicable, provide PSUR / PMCF trigger memo.
recommended_artifacts: CAPA Summary|Complaint Trending|PSUR / PMCF Trigger Memo

title: Justify software safety classification difference
acceptance_criteria: Document software safety classification rationale (IEC 62304 Class A/B/C).|If higher class, provide enhanced V&V evidence commensurate with risk.|Provide traceability between requirements, design, and verification.
recommended_artifacts: IEC 62304 Software Development Plan|Verification & Validation Evidence

title: Provide standards conformance rationale for identified gaps
acceptance_criteria: Provide applicable recognized standards list and gap analysis.|For each gap, provide rationale for alternative approach or test evidence.|Attach conformance test summaries where applicable.
recommended_artifacts: Conformance Test Summary|Standards Gap Rationale|Standards Matrix

title: Revalidate sterilization for new method
acceptance_criteria: Provide sterilization validation summary (SAL 10^-6 or as applicable).|If EO sterilization, provide residuals report within ISO 10993-7 limits.|Demonstrate package integrity maintained under new sterilization process.
recommended_artifacts: EO Residuals Report|Sterilization Validation (SAL)

title: Provide shelf-life and aging study evidence
acceptance_criteria: Provide accelerated aging study protocol and results.|If available, provide real-time aging data corroborating accelerated results.|Document acceptance criteria and test methods for aging endpoints.
recommended_artifacts: Bench Test Protocol|Bench Test Report|Performance Verification Summary

title: Update labeling and IFU to reflect device differences
acceptance_criteria: Update IFU text to reflect any differences from predicate.|Add/update warnings and contraindications as applicable.|Verify claims in labeling are supported by verification/validation evidence.
recommended_artifacts: IFU Draft|Warnings / Precautions Update

title: Verify packaging integrity and sterile barrier system
acceptance_criteria: Provide packaging integrity / seal strength test results.|Demonstrate sterile barrier maintained through distribution simulation.|If applicable, provide accelerated aging data supporting new packaging.
recommended_artifacts: Bench Test Report|Packaging Integrity / Seal Strength
